item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Look at it plainly: it only works if it's taken consistently, and consistency comes from routine, not memory. You already run a structured day with set anchor points, so use them. Tie your dose to one that never moves, something you do every single day without thinking. If you're ever unsure about timing, side effects, or a missed dose, that's a question for your prescriber or pharmacist, not a guess. Your action: attach your medication to one fixed daily habit, starting today.
